Messages.Author: cofius
Messages.Body:
when a minoin in combat with mental patient plays combat ends is the mental patient burned at the end of the combat.. thank you

Mortal with 1 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Escaped Mental Patient can enter combat with any minion controlled by another Methuselah as a  action. The Patient can strike: hand strike at +1 damage, aggravated. Burn him at the end of combat if he does so.

Messages.Author: Suoli
Messages.Body:
The combat ends before the Mental Patient can "execute" his intended strike, so no, he doesn't burn.
